publisher: deepseek.ai — The Independent DeepSeek Guide (not affiliated with DeepSeek)

entries.title: Full application API suite for deepseek-flash
entries.summary: Web search, file input, URL reading and model safety become available for deepseek-flash in the Messages, Responses and Chat Completions APIs. DeepSeek also adds standalone Search and Fetch, OCR, speech-to-text and text-to-speech APIs, plus an open-source demo chat client.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 replaces V4.1-Flash
entries.summary: The model behind deepseek-flash is upgraded to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017. The way you call it and the price stay the same. DeepSeek also opens its own search API.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash released, Flash prices cut
entries.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, with native image understanding, ships as deepseek-flash and Flash prices come down (from 04:00 UTC). V4-Flash and V4-Flash-Vision-Exp are retired; their names are routed to V4.1-Flash. V4-Pro stays available with unchanged billing.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp (experimental)
entries.summary: An experimental multimodal version of V4-Flash, under its own model name.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro GA, and peak / off-peak pricing announced
entries.summary: V4-Pro reaches general availability with stronger agent skills, native Responses API support for Codex, and low / high / max thinking effort. DeepSeek announces peak and off-peak pricing, with off-peak at half the peak price, taking effect at 16:00 UTC on 16 August 2026.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash public beta (V4-Flash-0731)
entries.summary: A re-post-trained V4-Flash (same architecture and size as the preview) goes into public beta with stronger agent skills and Responses API support for Codex. V4-Pro and the app are unchanged.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro and DeepSeek-V4-Flash released
entries.summary: The V4 generation arrives on the existing base URL, with OpenAI and Anthropic compatible interfaces. The old deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner names are scheduled to stop on 24 July 2026 and until then map to V4-Flash without and with thinking.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V3.2, plus the temporary V3.2-Speciale
entries.summary: deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner move to DeepSeek-V3.2. V3.2-Speciale runs on a temporary endpoint until 15 December 2025, without tool calls.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp
entries.summary: Both API names move to the experimental V3.2-Exp.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus
entries.summary: An update to V3.1 with more consistent language and better coding and search agents.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V3.1, one hybrid model for chat and reasoning
entries.summary: V3.1 serves both names: deepseek-chat without thinking, deepseek-reasoner with thinking.

entries.title: DeepSeek-R1-0528
entries.summary: An upgraded R1 with large gains on maths, science and coding tests; it can use more tokens per answer than the first R1.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V3-0324
entries.summary: An upgraded V3 with better reasoning, front-end code, Chinese writing and function calling.

entries.title: DeepSeek-R1, the reasoning model
entries.summary: R1 launches as deepseek-reasoner and makes DeepSeek known worldwide.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V3
entries.summary: deepseek-chat moves to V3. The API itself does not change.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V2.5-1210
entries.summary: A final V2.5 update with better maths and coding, plus improved file upload and web page summaries.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V2.5 merges Chat and Coder
entries.summary: V2 Chat and Coder-V2 become one model, reachable under both names.

entries.title: Context caching on disk
entries.summary: Repeated prompt prefixes are cached automatically and billed at a much lower cache-hit price.

entries.title: DeepSeek-Coder-V2-0724
entries.summary: An update to the coding model. The next day the API gains JSON mode, function calling and fill-in-the-middle completion.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V2-0628
entries.summary: An update to V2 Chat with better coding, maths and role-play.

entries.title: DeepSeek-Coder-V2-0614
entries.summary: Coder-V2 arrives on the API.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V2-0517
entries.summary: The first entry in DeepSeek's API change log: V2 Chat with better instruction following and JSON output.
